{{Quote|Rimsoo Seven, Admiral, sir.|The Myneyrsh|<ref name="MedStar I: Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>}}
This '''driver''', a young [[Myneyrsh]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], piloted a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] on the planet [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. He was hired by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tarnese Bleyd]] to ferry him to [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]], a mobile temporay hospital for [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] injured while combating the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the name of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He carried a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] issued to him, though his passenger believed that if a dangerous situation arose, his driver would use a [[Knife/Legends|combat knife]] that was hung around his neck with a wire.

==Personality and traits==
It was very uncommon to see a Myneyrsh off their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], more so to see one with a technological weapon like a blaster or piloting a ship of any kind. Myneyrshi had a natural aversion to technology due to many years of being oppressed by such tools.
